content: Perhaps all the dragons in our lives are princesses who are only waiting to see us act, just once, with beauty and courage.
author: Rainer Maria Rilke
sourceWork: Rainer Maria Rilke's Essays & Philosophical Writings
story:
Preserved as part of Rainer Maria Rilke's enduring intellectual legacy, this reflection addresses the fundamental nature of courage and courage. Across his life and work, Rainer Maria Rilke returned repeatedly to the conviction that personal integrity, honest observation, and clarity of purpose are the foundational pillars of a life well-lived.

Contemplating this truth invites us to step back from the frantic rush of daily demands. By examining our assumptions with fresh eyes, we discover the inner grounding necessary to act with wisdom and quiet conviction.
reflectionPrompt: What authentic choice would you make right now if fear were completely off the table?
